checked.claim: Keep Watch's start card (namesIn) and a critical tail's card (standingIn) name a Spectator's token - a kept death's watcher among them, under the dead student's name - where movement.mjs countsAsPresent leaves Spectators out.
checked.why: Read the whole road. ensureDeadSpectator makes the watcher as type character with FLAGS.spectator and an unhidden token where the body lies, and killCharacter calls it with kept: true for a death the GMs keep (death.mjs:203), so the watcher exists while the death is secret. isDeadForGm is deadIn(actor, pendingDeath): the watcher's own id has no death row and no deceased flag, so it is not dead. hiddenByGm reads doc.hidden, false for the watcher's token; the Spectator's hiding is visibility.mjs's display only. roomOfToken is plain geometry with no Spectator rule. namesIn skips only non-characters, token.hidden, skip, a Monokuma and isDeadForGm; standingIn adds a Monocub; neither reads FLAGS.spectator (grep of 'spectator' over watch-gm.mjs and tail-gm.mjs: none). countsAsPresent refuses the flag. The watcher's token even stands in the body's room without walking, so a watch posted there names it at once. The only test of startWatches, E74-T4 (tests-tier2.mjs:101682-101735), stands a watcher and one ordinary student in the room, no Spectator; no test reaches standingIn with one. Minor holds: a particular situation (a Spectator in the post or the tail's room), a false name on a whispered card.

checked.ref: hints_for_other_passes.stale_windows[0] / the GMs' 'Who you hear' list on a GM who is not the primary
checked.claim: The list's eavesdroppers repaint on drpgEavesdropChanged, which fires on the primary alone, so another GM's list stays stale.
checked.why: The hook is local and called only by changed() on the browser that runs start/end (eavesdrop-gm.mjs:216-219), and the header comment at :47 does overstate it. But the list is repainted by other roads the hint did not trace: paintControls repaints an open list (voice-tile.mjs:1056) and runs on voiceStep for LiveKit participantConnected/Disconnected (voice-tile.mjs:526-527), and updateUser of another user repaints it (1820-1821). Whether one of those fires on the other GM when an eavesdrop starts (the listener joins the room's channel, by decision) depends on which LiveKit room that GM is in; not settled from source. The reader wrote it as a hint, not a finding, which is right; no severity is given.
